faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Questions we actually get before a quote.

q1.question: How much does a website cost?
q1.answer: From €990 excl. VAT for a showcase site. Price depends on pages, features and design. You get a free, detailed quote within 12 hours.

q2.question: How long does delivery take?
q2.answer: A simple showcase site: usually 2–3 weeks. A shop or larger project: 4–6 weeks. The schedule is fixed in the quote before we start.

q3.question: Who handles hosting?
q3.answer: We can host the site on a fast, backed-up server, or work with the host you already have. It is stated in the quote.

q4.question: Can I edit the site myself?
q4.answer: Yes. You can change texts and images without coding. We show you how once the site is live.

q5.question: What happens after delivery?
q5.answer: One month of support is included for questions and small tweaks. Monthly maintenance is optional after that.

q6.question: Do I own the domain name?
q6.answer: Yes. The domain and the site content are yours. We keep no rights to your brand.

q7.question: Are prices excl. or incl. VAT?
q7.answer: All prices on this site are excl. VAT. Belgian VAT at 21% is added, unless you are VAT-registered with a valid intra-Community number.

q8.question: How do I pay?
q8.answer: As a rule: 50% on order, balance on delivery, by bank transfer. Instalments are possible above €3,000 excl. VAT.

services.title: What we do
services.subtitle: Showcase sites, shops, portfolios, redesigns and apps — for freelancers and SMEs in Belgium.

vitrine.title: Showcase website
vitrine.problem: Without a site, customers compare your competitors. With a slow or dated one, they leave.
vitrine.included: Clear pages, mobile, form, basic SEO, go-live.
vitrine.faqA: Yes if you do not sell a catalogue online. What matters: people understand what you do and can write to you in 30 seconds.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce
ecommerce.problem: Selling only in-store or on social media misses people who order in the evening.
ecommerce.included: Catalogue, cart, payment, order emails, simple admin.
ecommerce.faqA: We pick the tool for your volume and products — not for the trend. Goal: you can add a product without calling us.

portfolio.title: Portfolio site
portfolio.short: Show the work, get the jobs.
portfolio.problem: A PDF or Instagram is not a page in your name that people can Google.
portfolio.faqQ: Is this for photographers and creatives?
portfolio.faqA: Yes. The site should show 8–20 strong projects, not everything. We edit with you.

custom-app.title: Custom web app
custom-app.short: A business tool, not a brochure.
custom-app.problem: Spreadsheets, email and three tools that do not talk: that is lost time.
custom-app.included: Scoping, user access, business features, hosting, training.
custom-app.faqA: Usually from €4,990 excl. VAT. We split the work into phases so you pay for what you actually use.

refonte.title: Website redesign
refonte.short: Keep what works, drop the rest.
refonte.problem: Your site is six years old, slow, and Google barely shows it.
refonte.included: Quick audit, new design, reused content, redirects, go-live.
refonte.faqQ: Do we have to start from scratch?
refonte.faqA: Not always. We keep what converts (copy, reviews, pages Google likes) and change the rest.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.problem: A site with no updates eventually breaks, gets hacked, or drops in Google.
maintenance.included: Backups, updates, small fixes, a contact point.
maintenance.faqA: No. You can run it yourself. Maintenance is for when you do not want to think about it.

about.title: About
about.metaTitle: Houdaifa Hamouchi, web developer in Belgium
about.intro: I’m Houdaifa Hamouchi. I build websites and applications for freelancers and SMEs in Belgium, under the name HohoSolutions.

story.title: My background
story.p1: I’m a full-stack developer: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Laravel, Prisma. I’m completing a Graduaat Programmeren at Erasmushogeschool Brussel (degree expected in 2027).
story.p2: From February to May 2025 I interned as a backend developer at Bpost: Node.js, TypeScript, CI/CD and team code reviews. I’ve been freelancing through HohoSolutions since January 2026.

legal.title: Why the legal side matters here
legal.description: I also have a legal background, including internships at law firms. That changes what I deliver: legal notice, terms and GDPR are not a copy-paste in the footer. Your site should stand up to a client — and to a check.

languages.title: FR, NL, EN
languages.description: French and Dutch are my native languages; English is professional. You don’t have to translate your brief: we work in the language of your business.
